framework: DIFC Data Protection Regulations, Consolidated Version No. 2, Regulation 10 (autonomous and semi-autonomous systems)
requirement_paraphrase: Deployer/Operator must provide on request evidence of algorithms that make the System seek human intervention where processing may have an unfair or discriminatory impact, together with a risk and impact assessment of unjust bias or High Risk Processing arising from the System's inputs.
what_is_tested: Bias/unfair-impact risk and impact assessment; human-intervention triggers
who_tests: Deployer/Operator (self-assessment, available to affected party on request)

framework: NCA 'Draft of AI Cybersecurity Guidelines' (AICG-1:2026), draft for public consultation (closed 5 Aug 2026)
requirement_paraphrase: Conduct a cybersecurity risk assessment that classifies AI agents' actions by potential impact, likelihood and reversibility, and apply appropriate safeguards.
what_is_tested: Cybersecurity risk of AI agent actions

framework: EU AI Act (Reg. (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744)
clause_or_page: EC AI Act policy page, 'Application timeline' paragraph
requirement_paraphrase: Commission page states the Act became applicable on 2 August 2026 with exceptions: prohibitions and AI literacy from 2 Feb 2025; governance and GPAI obligations from 2 Aug 2025; Annex I high-risk to 2 Aug 2028; Annex III to 2 Dec 2027; AI Omnibus political agreement 7 May 2026, in force 27 July 2026.

framework: EU AI Act - GPAI Code of Practice (Safety and Security chapter)
requirement_paraphrase: Safety mitigations must be robust under adversarial pressure, and signatories carry out post-market monitoring (feedback channels, incident forms, bug bounties and similar) to inform whether the risk stays acceptable.

framework: US NIST AI RMF 1.0 (NIST AI 100-1, January 2023)
requirement_paraphrase: Identify and document scientific integrity and TEVV considerations, including experimental design, data collection/selection (representativeness, suitability), system trustworthiness and construct validation.
what_is_tested: Validity of test design and data

framework: EU AI Act (Reg. (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744)
requirement_paraphrase: High-risk systems must comply with the Section 2 requirements taking account of intended purpose and the generally acknowledged state of the art, with the Art. 9 risk management system taken into account.

framework: EU AI Act (Reg. (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744)
requirement_paraphrase: Notified-body certificates are valid for the period stated, at most five years for Annex I systems and four years for Annex III systems, extendable at the provider's request after re-assessment; where a system no longer meets Section 2 requirements the body must, applying proportionality, suspend, withdraw or restrict the certificate unless the provider takes corrective action within the deadline set by the body.

framework: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1755 (arrangements under Reg. (EU) 2024/1689 Arts 92(6), 101(6))
requirement_paraphrase: Independent experts evaluating GPAI models for the Commission must be independent of providers (shared ownership, governance, staff or resources and contracts with the provider over at least the prior 12 months are considered), declare interests, and keep confidentiality and information-security protocols; providers may submit reasoned observations on appointed experts; experts are selected by call for expressions of interest (standing list possible), directly from the scientific panel, or under the Financial Regulation.
what_is_tested: Independence and selection of external evaluators of GPAI models

framework: Dubai AI Integration Matrix Framework for Government Organizations (Dubai Digital Authority, August 2025, Version 1.0 per front matter; earlier listing date 28 Apr 2026 conflicts)
clause_or_page: Ch. 10.3 (AI Ethics Policy) and 10.2 (Initiative Approval), printed p. 87
requirement_paraphrase: States that every AI initiative under DDA must demonstrate alignment with DDA's ethical principles and undergo rigorous validation for ethical compliance across its lifecycle, and passes a standard approval workflow including technical feasibility, business case, risk evaluation and resource sign-off.
what_is_tested: Ethical compliance validation; initiative risk evaluation

framework: DoH Abu Dhabi Responsible AI Standard V1 (Oct 2025)
requirement_paraphrase: AI systems rated high risk must undergo conformity assessments both before and after deployment, coordinated with DoH's Data and Digital Governance Office.
what_is_tested: Conformity with ethical standards and statutory requirements

framework: Singapore Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI (version read: v1.0, 22 Jan 2026; v1.5 not read)
requirement_paraphrase: Test in real or realistic environments that mirror production (balancing realism against risk of real-world side effects), test repeatedly across varied datasets to observe low-probability behaviours and stability, and evaluate results at scale using different methods per workflow part; the source describes current industry solutions as LLM or agent evaluators, or human evaluation (practice described, not a recommendation).
